description: 100% Zoho Catalyst NoSQL Document Collections for Schema-Flexible AI Data.

collections.description: Stores raw and formatted OCR text extracted by Zia OCR from evidence documents.
JSON payloads of persons, vehicles, weapons, and locations extracted by Zia NLP/Vision.
Historical audit of prompts sent to and answers generated by Catalyst QuickML LLM.
Dynamic AI-generated executive summaries and timeline narrations for ongoing cases.
Multi-turn chat logs and context parameters for the AI Crime Intelligence Assistant.
Step-by-step reasoning logs and confidence weights from AI pattern matching.
Feature attribution weights, SHAP values, and bias check scores for model predictions.
EXIF data, file size, mime types, and Stratus bucket URI mappings for evidence uploads.
Investigator bounding boxes, timestamp markers, and notes attached to evidence files.
Clusters of modus operandi (MO) and cross-jurisdictional crime series discovered by AI.
